description: Search Agena's own European AI and developer events that have not ended. Keyless. Returns JSON with total, a `next` page link, and per event: local start and end with time zone and UTC offset, venue and address, price, organiser, description, registration URL, and a one-event calendar (.ics) URL.

city.description: City slug or name, any case: zurich, geneva, lausanne, berlin, munich, vienna, london, paris, amsterdam, lisbon, helsinki, rome, barcelona, madrid, milan, stockholm, copenhagen, dublin, brussels, warsaw, prague, oslo.

country.description: Country code or name: CH, DE, AT, GB, FR, NL, PT, FI, IT, ES, SE, DK, IE, BE, PL, CZ, NO.

format.description: meetup, conference, workshop, hackathon, online, hybrid, other, or in_person.

from.description: ISO date or datetime. Inclusive lower bound.

offset.description: Skip this many matches. Use the `next` link of the previous page, or page.

page.description: Page number, 1 first. Use offset or page, not both.

q.description: Free-text query. Narrows the matches by keyword and topic, with match reasons. No LLM.

to.description: ISO date or datetime. Inclusive upper bound.

topic.description: Comma-separated topic slugs or names, any case: ai-agents (AI agents), llms (LLMs), machine-learning (Machine learning), robotics (Robotics), developer-tools (Developer tools), research (Research), hackathons (Hackathons), startups (Startups), ai-finance (AI × Finance). "finance" means ai-finance.

name: search_events
